title: Senior Advisor at Wasp Barcode Technologies Believes HPE Needs a More Aggressive Sales Approach to Defend AI Infrastructure Share
expert: Senior Advisor at Wasp Barcode Technologies; former CEO of a $1.3B networking VAR (~30 years IT sales)
verdict: From the channel, a customer's server order was repriced 20% higher two weeks after acceptance on component costs, HPE's 30-day price hold (orders up to $1 million) only matches Dell and Lenovo, and the expert ranks Dell 1st on lead times while HPE loses share.

Supply, not demand, sets FY27 revenue: 🔴 Revenue rising on component cost "without the unit count increasing"; revenue could drop significantly if memory prices fall; consistent with mgmt saying FY26 growth was ASP-driven with units supply-limited (SB #58666). → Tenet 2 (C&AI supply-secured) ↓ [15 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268910&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse5714&hl=fse5714,fse5736,fse5841,fse6152,fse6331&page=2)
Cloud & AI margin vs Networking margin: 🟡 Order repriced 20% higher two weeks after acceptance (first-hand); HPE's 30-day hold up to $1 million is "me-too"; matches mgmt's view that LTAs assure supply, not price (SB #59919). → Tenet 3 (C&AI margin) ↓ [5 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268910&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse26512&hl=fse26512,fse26700,fse26797&page=2)
Share vs Dell: 🔴 Dell ranked 1st with the shortest lead times; HPE ~6% DC switching vs Cisco ~28% (hearsay); same direction as HPE trad servers +59% vs Dell +122% last quarter (SB #50228). → Tenet 4 (share vs Dell) ↓ [7 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268910&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse28811&hl=fse28811,fse28852&page=2)

changes: Pricing: customer order repriced 20% higher two weeks after acceptance (expert) vs mgmt saying >$30B purchase commitments assure supply, not price (SB #59919): consistent, input-cost exposure persists.
Revenue mix: component cost lifting revenue without unit growth (expert) vs mgmt saying FY26 growth was ASP-driven with units supply-limited (SB #58666): consistent.
Share: Dell ranked 1st with shortest lead times (expert) vs HPE trad servers +59% / AI -6% vs Dell +122% / +100% in the July quarter (SB #50228): consistent, share loss continuing.
Memory: +20%-30% in 2027 (estimate) vs Citi on mgmt seeing memory relief unlikely before 2028 (SB #51463): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (C&AI supply-secured): ↓ — expert says revenue growth is component-price driven without matching unit growth, so a memory price fall would cut revenue.
Tenet 3 (FY27 EPS / C&AI margin): ↓ — order repriced 20% two weeks after acceptance; 30-day hold up to $1 million shifts cost risk onto HPE on held quotes.
Tenet 4 (share vs Dell): ↓ — Dell ranked 1st on lead times and direct sales; HPE ~6% DC switching share vs Cisco ~28% (hearsay).
Tenet 1 (Networking compounds): → — Juniper seen as path to grow from ~6% DC switching share, but no figures on HPE networking orders.
